builds.name: Reference: Mixed tank
builds.goal: Reference for Sejuani: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: A durable initiator who combines a dash and ranged bola with Frost-stack stuns, especially alongside melee allies. Measure Frost stacks generated by actual melee allies and own attacks, then stun cooldown. W/HP damage and AP spells must be separated; do not award instant ally stacks. Health, armor/MR and close-range effects test reliable frontline contact.
builds.summary: Health, armor/MR and close-range effects test reliable frontline contact.
testPlan: Kit question for Sejuani: Measure Frost stacks generated by actual melee allies and own attacks, then stun cooldown. W/HP damage and AP spells must be separated; do not award instant ally stacks.

Start with the early core (Matchup defense or Heartsteel only if stacking is safe) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Use this as the control for the other three routes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: Health, armor/MR and close-range effects test reliable frontline contact. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern.

Q evidence: Sejuani charges forward, knocking enemies into the air. The charge stops after hitting an enemy champion. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: Heartsteel stacks must be finite; percent-health damage and kiting punish excessive health.

The route fails Sejuani's stated kit question: Measure Frost stacks generated by actual melee allies and own attacks, then stun cooldown. W/HP damage and AP spells must be separated; do not award instant ally stacks.
Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility.
tradeoffs: Heartsteel stacks must be finite; percent-health damage and kiting punish excessive health.
Full cost 15,700 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
The reference is a research control, not a claim of the current highest-win-rate build.
buyOrder: Matchup defense or Heartsteel only if stacking is safe. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Keep appropriate boots while building the early core; swap boots only when the measured matchup justifies it.
Unending Despair, Spirit Visage, Jak'Sho, The Protean are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.
coverageNotes: No numerical damage or survival adapter exists for this champion. Loading this proposal opens a manual test sheet, not calculated damage.
Source formulas remain in Champion kit. Symbolic values, unresolved tokens and helper records are evidence to inspect, not a certified executable simulator.
Legal source item/rune references were checked; retained map flags cannot prove every live-shop condition. Confirm shop eligibility, exact on-hit/on-attack rules and real proc cooldowns in game.

kitEvidence.formula:
Sejuani throws her True Ice bola, Stunning and revealing the first enemy champion hit for [1] second and dealing [125 / 150 / 175 + (0.4) × AP] magic damage.

If the bola travels at least 25% of its range, it Stuns and reveals for [1.5] seconds instead. It then also creates an ice storm that Slows surrounding enemies by [80]% for [2] seconds. All affected enemies take [200 / 300 / 400 + (0.8) × AP] magic damage.

Sejuani becomes immune to Slows and gains [10 + (0.75) × Stat(1)[statFormula=2]] Armor and [10 + (0.75) × Stat(6)[statFormula=2]] Magic Resist after not taking damage from champions or large jungle monsters for [characterLevelInterpolation(12 → 6; raw flags preserved)] seconds.

Sejuani's first Attack against enemies she has Stunned deals an additional [0.1] max Health magic damage.

Passive: Nearby melee allied champions' Attacks apply a stack to champions and jungle monsters.

Active: Sejuani deals [55 / 105 / 155 / 205 / 255 + (0.7) × AP] magic damage to target enemy with 4 stacks and Stuns them for [1] second.

Sejuani swings her flail, dealing [5 / 15 / 25 / 35 / 45 + (0.3) × AP + (0.04) × Stat(12)] physical damage and Knocking Back minions and jungle monsters. She then lashes out again, dealing [5 / 25 / 45 / 65 / 85 + (0.6) × AP + (0.08) × Stat(12)] physical damage and briefly Slowing targets.

Both swings apply stacks of Permafrost.
Sejuani charges, dealing [90 / 140 / 190 / 240 / 290 + (0.75) × AP] magic damage to enemies and Knocking them Up for [0.5] seconds. The charge ends after hitting an enemy champion.

builds.name: Solo frost attack
builds.summary: Test faster self attacks to enable E without allied melee help.
builds.goal: Test faster self attacks to enable E without allied melee help.
builds.hypothesis: W contributes Permafrost stacks and nearby melee allies can add stacks, but solo testing must count only Sejuani's own actions. Nashor and Dusk support real attacks; E has 0.7 AP and the passive shatter adds target-health magic damage after her stun. Health also strengthens both W swings.
testPlan: Required state: No allied stack contribution, unstunned target and four verified stacks before E.
Count stacks per W swing and ordinary attack, then isolate E and first post-stun attack packets.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Slow stack delivery loses E access or expiring armor leaves the attacker vulnerable.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Repeated on-hits are not proven to add extra Permafrost stacks.
Confidence: speculative. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Nashor's Tooth, Dusk and Dawn, Riftmaker, Abyssal Mask, Rabadon's Deathcap, Berserker's Greaves. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

builds.name: Health flail resistance
builds.summary: Combine health-scaled physical W with a deliberately refreshed Frost Armor entry.
builds.goal: Combine health-scaled physical W with a deliberately refreshed Frost Armor entry.
builds.hypothesis: W includes 4% and 8% health Stat terms over its two swings; Cleaver can benefit its confirmed physical packets. Passive Frost Armor adds resistance after avoiding champion/large-monster damage, while Warmog supports disengage and health budget. E then supplies a stun for the shatter attack.
testPlan: Required state: Frost Armor refreshed before Q entry and finite health/bonus resistance state recorded.
Compare W hits and incoming damage with Frost Armor active versus expired at equal health.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Incidental large-monster damage delays armor refresh or W's second swing misses.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Frost Armor is not continuously active merely because resistance items are equipped.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
